description: Triage whether the project of the current repository is affected by a vulnerability, given either by its CVE id or by a free-text security or vulnerability description, by consulting the published VEX status of the project, the CVE record or the Internet/Web, and the project artifacts, and emit an AFFECTED, NOT-AFFECTED, or INCONCLUSIVE verdict, optionally with a brief reason. Use when the user asks whether the project is "affected" by, "vulnerable" to, or "exposed" to a CVE or a vulnerability, or calls to "triage" one.
